message.entry: Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": the InputValue time series is invalid: {2}. Give [t, v_1, ..., v_n] with one column per input name (t in seconds from t_start: finite, strictly increasing, starting at 0) or a table with the variables Time and the input names.
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": InputMethod "{2}" is given for a constant InputValue. The method interpolates a time series [t, v]; leave it out for a constant.
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": InputUnit "{2}" is not a component of network "{3}". Specify the tag of a component connected to a bus (see string(net.a_Bus) and the component tags).
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": InputName {2} is not an input of "{3}". Available inputs: {4}.
Fault "{0}" of scenario "{1}": {2} is not a bus or branch of network "{3}". Specify bus tags (see string(net.a_Bus)) or branch tags (see string(net.a_Branch)).
Fault "{0}" of scenario "{1}": the targets mix buses ({2}) and branches ({3}). Add the bus faults and the branch faults with separate add_fault calls.
Fault "{0}" of scenario "{1}" on {2}: {3}. A bus fault takes Status "BG" (the default) and no Point; a branch fault needs Status "3LG" (one circuit) or "6LG" (all circuits) and Point (0 < Point < 1).

Fault "{0}" of scenario "{1}" on branch {2}: Point {3} is not in the open interval (0, 1). Point is the position from the from end (0) to the to end (1); fault a bus at an end of the branch with add_fault(bus, ...).

Parallel event "{0}" of scenario "{1}": {2} is not a component, global controller, local controller or branch of network "{3}". Specify the tag of a component connected to a bus, of a controller, or of a branch (see string(net.a_Branch)).

Event "{0}" of scenario "{1}" on {2}: {3}. Each target of an event has two rows with the tag: the start (Status "BG", "3LG" or "6LG" of a fault; "open" of a unit, "3open" or "6open" of a branch) and then the end ("none" of a fault, "close" of a parallel event). add_fault, add_trip and add_open_branch add them.

Events "{0}" and "{1}" of scenario "{2}" overlap on {3} ({4} and {5}). Two faults, or two parallel events (trips, branch openings), of one target may touch but not overlap. Change the time spans, or remove one with remove_disturbance.
Event "{0}" of scenario "{1}": Status "{2}" on branch {3} needs at least two circuits, but the branch has one. Use "6LG" or "6open" for a branch of one circuit.
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": OffsetUnit "{2}" is not a component of network "{3}". Specify the tag of a component connected to a bus (see string(net.a_Bus) and the component tags).
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": OffsetState {2} is not a state of "{3}". Available states: {4}.
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": TimeSpan {2} is invalid. Specify real numbers without NaN, with t_start not later than t_end.

Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": TimeSpan {2} has no duration, but a fault, trip, branch opening or input needs one. Specify [t_start, t_end] with t_start earlier than t_end, e.g. [1, 1.05]. Only an offset can use a single time.
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}": {2} has {3} element(s) for {4} element(s) of {5}. Give at least one name, and one value per name or a single value for all names.
Disturbance "{0}" of scenario "{1}" (time {2}) lies entirely outside the simulation time {3} and has no effect. Change its time or the simulation time.
Scenario "{1}" already has a disturbance with the tag "{0}" (in tab_event, tab_offset or tab_input). Give each offset and input its own tag; add_fault, add_trip and add_open_branch number theirs.

The disturbance tag "{0}" of scenario "{1}" is reserved. Use another tag; t1, t2, Properties, Row, Variables, an empty tag, NoAction followed by digits (the phase table), and Fault or Parallel followed by digits (the tags of add_fault, add_trip and add_open_branch) are not available.
Scenario "{1}" has no disturbance with the tag {0}.
